svg.text: From the host machine up to the survey mission. Each layer only uses the one below it; everything from layer 1 up runs inside Docker containers.
sim ↔ real boundary · same ROS topics: /imu/data /dvl/twist /depth/pose /gps/fix /usbl/pose /multibeam/submap
Data flows up from the sensors to the mission; commands flow back down to the actuators in Gazebo through ros_gz_bridge. Switch RMW to CycloneDDS with RMW_IMPLEMENTATION in .env.
